Stroud was under fire again behind a shaky O-line. Tampa won but looked flat, giving up nearly 300 passing yards and missing Tristan Wirfs up front. If Stroud settles in early, the Texans have a real shot to punch first on Monday night. (5U) CHARGERS -3-110 The Las Vegas Raiders are 1-11 (8.3%) in their last 12 games as an underdog. The Los Angeles Chargers are 8-2 (80.0%) against the spread in their last 10 games as a favorite. Herbert and the Chargers dominated Kansas City with scoring drives in every quarter and a swarming defense that held the Chiefs to 5-of-14 on third down. The Raiders edged New England behind Geno Smith, but it was far less convincing. With Harbaugh's impact already showing, the Chargers look primed to cover in Vegas.
